summary.text: Indiana Thompson, also known as Indy, is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 67, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican David Armstrong.
A small business owner and educator, he owns Pinecrest Golf Course in Dallas, Wisconsin, according to a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Indiana Thompson earned a high school diploma from Chetek-Weyerhaeuser High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin, Stout in 2019, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in Chetek, graduated summa cum laude from UW-Stout in Golf Enterprise Management, and worked as general manager of Big Fish Golf Course during his senior year.
He said he bought Pinecrest Golf Course in 2021 and also works as head girls golf coach and assistant boys golf coach at Chetek-Weyerhaeuser and as a substitute teacher.
Thompson said in the survey that he wants to end the private school voucher program and regulate the insurance industry to help keep rural hospitals open.
He also said he wants to reduce regulatory delays facing small businesses that seek financing.
